[size=5]Welcome, dear friends![/size]
[size=5] Let me introduce to you a work of many hours and sleepless nights: [/size]
[size=5]Mila's Foliage Overhaul [/size]
[size=5]for the Stardew Valley game.[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]Blue Grass Recolor[/url][size=5] from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53298111]collingbe[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url][size=5] from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91802318]grapeponta[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley World Recolor 1.5 Update (The Dirty Fix)[/url][size=5]  from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51485186]strangelyliteral[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor[/url][size=5] from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38816245]acerbicon[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url][size=5] from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14668]Nari's Naturally Valley[/url][size=5] from [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45972757]Narianka
[/url]

[size=5]IT HAS MANY USEFUL SETTINGS, you could change in game on the fly, [/size]
[size=5]using [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=5]![/size]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q9lrWaa.png[/img]


[size=5]It is safe to install and uninstall this mod in any phase of your game![/size]

[size=5]Just manually unpack the archive and drag and drop the folder named[/size]

[size=5]"[CP] zMila's Foliage"  into your "MODs" folder. [/size]

[size=5]To uninstall:[/size]

[size=5]delete the folder "[CP] zMila's Foliage" from your "MODs" folder.[/size]

[size=5]Remember to put my mod BELOW any other recolors or mods, [/size]
[size=5]contain the same files (e.g. trees, SpringObjects, etc.), if you have any, [/size]
[size=5]to see changes in your game![/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8srPFG7.png[/img]
[size=5]This mod could never see the light without 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url] from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/73472878]dugongkebalik[/url],
because I use this mod as a template
and one of the Island tile bushes is belong to Annette![/size]

[size=5]Many thanks for the Concerned Ape for the game,[/size]
[size=5]Many thanks for the mods authors making this possible![/size]


[size=5]Thank YOU for reading and attention![/size]
[size=3](Please, if you like it don't forget to endorse. For me it's quite important)[/size]
[size=5]Enjoy your game![/size]

[size=5][img]https://c.tenor.com/V07mRV2tHE0AAAAM/little-twin-stars-kiki.gif[/img]
